summary: A wait blown inside a fanout agent body is absorbed by the dispatcher as "did not commit", so the helper's stated refusal never reaches the case that held it
acceptance: a wait that blows inside a fanout agent body is recorded where the case can read it, and every case holding one asserts that list empty before asserting its verdict — so the blown wait reds with its own message rather than as an entry that did not commit
tests: a wait blown inside a fanout agent body reds the case that held it rather than surfacing as an entry that did not commit
